scenarios.name: Controlled nominal boundary approach
scenarios.purpose: Measure detection and presentation timing for one known synthetic object in the frozen passive fixture.
inputOrThreatProfile: One known synthetic object approaching on the frozen path
scenarios.duration: One hour maximum per campaign session
scenarios.coverageGeometry: Frozen path and boundary coordinates from fixture synthetic-observation-v1

operatorConditions.priorKnowledge: Operator knows the target class but not the exact presentation timestamp
permittedIntervention: Abort the run for safety or fixture failure

degradedConditions: One recorded replay with delayed observation delivery for diagnostic analysis
assumptions: The exact candidate architecture configuration is loaded before each scored run.

metrics.name: Detection before boundary crossing
metrics.quantity: Whether the detection event occurs before the frozen boundary-crossing timestamp
metrics.measurementMethod: Compare the first valid detection-event timestamp with the ground-truth boundary-crossing timestamp for each scored pass.
metrics.samplingMethod: Ten scored single-object passes using the frozen path and target profile
metrics.allowedUncertainty: Timestamp uncertainty must remain below 10 milliseconds; otherwise the run is inconclusive.
metrics.failureCondition: Any valid scored pass lacks a detection before boundary crossing.
limitations: Known synthetic target class and frozen geometry only.

metrics.name: Observation-to-presentation latency
metrics.quantity: Elapsed time between first qualifying observation and operator presentation
metrics.measurementMethod: Subtract the first qualifying observation timestamp from the corresponding presentation timestamp under the shared run clock.
metrics.samplingMethod: Measure one latency value for each of ten valid scored passes
metrics.allowedUncertainty: Combined timestamp uncertainty must remain below 10 milliseconds.
metrics.failureCondition: The 95th percentile latency exceeds 2 seconds or any required event lacks a valid timestamp.

instrumentation.name: Qualification run clock
instrumentation.accuracy: Better than 10 milliseconds across the bounded run
instrumentation.clockSource: One host monotonic clock distributed through the event recorder
instrumentation.dataFormat: RFC3339 wall time plus monotonic nanoseconds in JSON Lines

instrumentation.name: Immutable event and intervention recorder
instrumentation.dataFormat: Append-only JSON Lines with per-record digest

comparators.name: Frozen synthetic operator requirement
limitations: This comparator establishes mission adequacy only; it is not a vendor-system baseline.

accountingBoundary.evaluationPeriod: Acquisition, integration, and one bounded qualification campaign
accountingBoundary.missionDenominator: One integrated candidate and ten valid scored passes in the frozen scenario

prohibitedActivities: Active transmission outside the isolated fixture
authorizations.timeBoundary: During the bounded qualification session only
authorizations.rationale: The fixture is passive, isolated, and contains no regulated active effect.
